title: Common providers: Hong Kong
coverage: Complete for the fixed carriers, the four mobile network operators, cable and the Hong Kong arms of the mainland carriers; business ISPs and data-centre networks are partial.
missing: Smaller business ISPs and data-centre networks
Regional and international carriers that hold a Hong Kong licence but are seldom the local access provider
Websites of HGC, SmarTone and China Mobile Hong Kong (each refused an automated request on the read date)

sources.name: Communications Authority (OFCA): online enquiry of telecommunications licences
sources.terms: The register is an interactive enquiry and its terms of reuse were not found on the read date: nothing is copied.
sources.result: The licensing page of the Authority names this enquiry as the list of carrier licensees. It was not queried; it is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Communications in Hong Kong
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 8 of 13 entries were found on the page under their name or one of their other names.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 10 of 13 websites answered an automated check; an address that did not answer, or that refused an automated request, is left empty. No support or status page was checked.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 18 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was another company or an unrelated name was left out.

sources.name: APNIC RDAP (the registry's own record of an AS number)
sources.terms: The APNIC Whois terms allow lookups for internet operational purposes and forbid bulk copying or redistribution without consent: nothing is copied.
sources.result: Read where the holder name in RIPEstat did not name the provider plainly.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: PeeringDB
sources.terms: The acceptable use policy forbids reproducing PeeringDB data outside approved operational purposes: nothing is copied; cited as a place to look up an AS number.

providers.name: HKT
providers.notes: Fixed and mobile (csl, 1O1O). AS4515 is its business internet service and AS38819 is the CSL mobile network. PCCW Global is in the international pack.

providers.name: HKBN
providers.notes: AS9381 and AS17444 are HKBN Enterprise Solutions, the business arm (formerly WTT and Wharf T&T).

providers.name: HGC
providers.notes: Fixed network and wholesale; Hutchison Global Communications until 2017.

providers.name: CITIC Telecom CPC
providers.notes: Business networks across Hong Kong and mainland China.

providers.name: Towngas Telecom
providers.notes: Fibre network and data centres; mostly wholesale and business.

providers.name: China Telecom Global
providers.notes: International arm of China Telecom (China pack), based in Hong Kong.

providers.name: China Unicom Global
providers.notes: International arm of China Unicom (China pack), based in Hong Kong.

providers.name: China Mobile International
providers.notes: International arm of China Mobile (China pack), based in Hong Kong.

providers.name: HARNET
aka: Hong Kong Academic and Research Network
providers.notes: The academic and research network of the universities, run by JUCC.
